﻿# Whisper Transcriber Suite v1.9.1

A small patch release on top of v1.9.0 for Windows and macOS.

## Download

| File | For | Size |
|---|---|---|
| [**WhisperTranscriberSuite-Installer-Windows-v1.9.1.exe**](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/releases/download/v1.9.1/WhisperTranscriberSuite-Installer-Windows-v1.9.1.exe) | **Windows — most people.** Normal installer; upgrades an older version in place. | 209 MB |
| [**WhisperTranscriberSuite-Portable-Windows-v1.9.1.zip**](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/releases/download/v1.9.1/WhisperTranscriberSuite-Portable-Windows-v1.9.1.zip) | Windows — unzip and run, no installation or admin rights. | 317 MB |
| [WhisperTranscriberSuite-v1.9.1-macOS-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/releases/download/v1.9.1/WhisperTranscriberSuite-v1.9.1-macOS-arm64.dmg) | Mac with Apple silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4…), macOS 14+ | 210 MB |
| [WhisperTranscriberSuite-v1.9.1-macOS-x64.dmg](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/releases/download/v1.9.1/WhisperTranscriberSuite-v1.9.1-macOS-x64.dmg) | Intel Mac, macOS 10.15+ | 262 MB |

Mac install steps — including the one-line Terminal install — are below.

## Changes

- **Video Tiling is locked to one approved stream.** The URL field now shows the approved stream pre-filled and greyed out; it can't be changed.
- **macOS:** video downloading works in the packaged app, and the bundled ffmpeg / ffprobe / ffplay / yt-dlp are found correctly.

## Installing on a Mac (the app is free but not signed by Apple)

**Easiest — one line in Terminal, no security warning at all** (files
downloaded by `curl` are not quarantined):

```bash
A=$([ "$(uname -m)" = arm64 ] && echo arm64 || echo x64); curl -fL -o /tmp/wts.dmg "https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/releases/download/v1.9.1/WhisperTranscriberSuite-v1.9.1-macOS-$A.dmg" && hdiutil attach -nobrowse -quiet -mountpoint /tmp/wts-dmg /tmp/wts.dmg && cp -R "/tmp/wts-dmg/Whisper Transcriber Suite.app" /Applications/ && hdiutil detach -quiet /tmp/wts-dmg && rm /tmp/wts.dmg && open "/Applications/Whisper Transcriber Suite.app"
```

**Or the usual way:** open the `.dmg`, drag *Whisper Transcriber Suite*
into *Applications*. The first time you open it macOS says it "can't be
opened because Apple cannot check it for malicious software". Then:

- **macOS 14 and older:** right-click (or Control-click) the app →
  **Open** → **Open**. Only needed once.
- **macOS 15 and newer:** click *Done*, then System Settings → Privacy &
  Security → scroll down → **Open Anyway**.
- Or in Terminal:
  `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Whisper Transcriber Suite.app"`

First launch asks where to keep the speech models (large files; the
default is fine). The model you pick downloads once, the first time you
transcribe.
